criteria.evidence: Recommends a dedicated read-only role with SELECT only on specific tables/views, column exclusion via views, and states the agent only needs to read.
Explicitly advises against giving the agent admin credentials, explaining risks (bad query, prompt injection, model mistake), and proposes a new role instead.

Restricts tool via read-only role, default_transaction_read_only, statement_timeout, row caps, parameterized functions, secret kept out of model, plus verification that writes and ungranted tables fail.
criteria.criterion: Restrict the tool to the minimum required authorization.
